messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a spike in 5xx from eu-west streaming blackbox probes starting ~03:20 UTC.

sam: same. Grafana panel 'streaming_probe_latency' tail is spiking. Not seeing CPU/GPU throttles in node-exporter for the pool.

tori: graphs show websocket handshake failures; connection reset during TLS handshake for a subset of IPs :thinking_face: 

ivan: those blackbox probes open a 10s websocket and push 512 tokens to simulate streaming. If autoscaler moves a pod while probe opens conn it can fold.

alex: FYI embedding checks are also running full 512 token prompts for multiple models — expensive. We're burning GPU cycles and probe tokens.

sam: suggestion: change baseline probes to lightweight health + quick single-token stream test, then escalate to full streaming test only on anomalies (dynamic sampling).

tori: agree. also add labels to probe metrics: `model_id`, `model_variant`, `seq_len_bucket`, `region`. That will help rule tuning and reduce false positives from quantization differences.

ivan: +1. We should also tag by `gpu_pool` so we can correlate with preemption/placement events.

alex: incidents-bot posted alert: `ALERT streaming_probe_error_rate > 0.8% for 3m` — that's noisy when we sample every 10s per region.

incidents-bot: New alert: streaming_probe_error_rate (eu-west) = 1.2% (5m window). See runbook: /runbooks/streaming-probes

sam: we can tune the Prometheus recording rules to use `increase()` over `rate()` and aggregate with `histogram_quantile()` to reduce flapping. Also add a `min_samples` label in the dashboard query.

alex: here's a quick probe config idea — use 1/10 sampling baseline, escalate to 1/2 after an anomaly window. config snippet:
```
blackbox_checks:
  - name: streaming_quick
    freq: 60s
    sample_rate: 0.1
    seq_len: 8
    timeout: 5s
  - name: streaming_full
    freq: 300s
    sample_rate: 0.01
    seq_len: 512
    timeout: 12s
    trigger_on: anomaly_in(streaming_quick, 3m)
```

tori: also add a circuit breaker on the probe side to avoid overwhelming overloaded GPUs during rolling updates. If `gpu_pressure > 0.8` then pause full probes for 10m.

ivan: cost note: switching to this sampling model should cut probe-related token spend ~75% for EU pools. Need finance sign-off to reallocate savings to runplay credits.

sam: can someone PR prometheus recording rules? I'll draft grafana panel changes (add seq_len and variant quick filters).

alex: assigned: @sam to grafana panels, @ivan to probe tagging, @tori to runbook update, @alex to promote sampling plan. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC :calendar:

tori: added runbook stub and a checklist for post-mitigation checks (SLO service, latency tail, error_rate). Will link PRs.

ivan: quick test: ran a local probe with `seq_len_bucket=8` and `model_variant=int8` — no false positives. next step: canary rollout to eu-west-2.

sam: ack. I'll open PRs for recording rules and dashboards this afternoon.

alex: thanks all — good plan. keep alerts muted during rollout and annotate in incidents channel.
